steps.note: the API built this case's state
Ensure RFQ counter-offer controls are available before testing their removal after withdrawal.
Ensure the Withdraw Project action is offered on the event.
Ensure the RFQ is available as an eRFX project event.
Withdraw the event from the project menu using the required reason.
Assert that the event is marked Withdrawn and that the withdrawal succeeded.
Open Order Activity to verify the withdrawal audit record.
Assert that the withdrawal reason is recorded in Order Activity.
Assert that counter-offer and withdrawal actions are no longer offered after withdrawal.
Navigate to the comparison and awarding area to check that awarding is no longer available.
Assert that the withdrawn event cannot start awarding.
Open the History tab where withdrawn events should appear.
Assert that the withdrawn RFQ is present in History with Withdrawn status.
